newsitem.title: USA: Quintiles Vice Chairman Haigh retires.
newsitem.headline: Quintiles Vice Chairman Haigh retires.

text.p: Quintiles Transnational Corp said Monday that Barrie Haigh had retired as vice chairman, effective immediately.
The company also said Dr. Virginia Weldon had been appointed to the board, effective November 13.
Haigh, 59, founded the contract pharmaceutical organization Innovex Ltd, which merged with Quintiles last year. Haigh said he intends to remain a major shareholder.
Weldon, 61, is senior vice president for public policy at Monsanto Co.
Quintiles provides full-service contract research, sales and marketing services to the worldwide pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device industries.
